data.cta: Reply YES for a quick setup call

script_parts.opening: Namaskar, Aakarshan Furniture se baat ho rahi hai? Ji, main IndiaMART se call kar raha hoon — dekh raha hoon ki pichle poore 30 dinon mein aapka account ek bhi din active nahi raha aur ek bhi enquiry nahi aayi, toh seedha aapse baat karna zaroori laga.
script_parts.diagnostic: Bhai ji, ye batayein — kya aapko lag raha hai ki platform pe jo buyers aa rahe hain wo aapke furniture products ke liye relevant nahi hain, ya phir aapko pata hi nahi chal raha ki leads kahan ja rahi hain? Matlab, last time jab aapne account check kiya tha, tab kya experience tha?
script_parts.value_demo: Ek important baat share karta hoon — aapka CQS score abhi 53 hai, jo 60 se neeche hai, aur iska seedha matlab hai ki aapka catalog search results mein upar nahi aa raha; is wajah se buyers aapko dekh hi nahi pa rahe, chahe demand ho ya na ho — aur furniture category mein is waqt demand tier Red hai, toh jo bhi limited traffic aa raha hai, usmein bhi visibility critical hai.
script_parts.action: Toh bhai ji, abhi is call pe hi ek kaam karte hain — main aapka catalog open karta hoon aur dekhte hain ki CQS 53 se 60+ tak le jaane ke liye konse 2-3 products mein images ya description update karni hai; aap apna account ek baar open karein, main guide karta hoon step by step.
script_parts.close: Bas itna karte hain — aaj ke call mein jo changes identify karein, unhe agle 2 dinon mein update kar lein, aur main 5 din baad ek short follow-up call karoonga yeh dekhne ke liye ki visibility mein koi improvement aayi ya nahi; theek lagta hai aapko?

script_parts_en.opening: Hello, am I speaking with Aakarshan Furniture? I'm calling from IndiaMART — I can see that over the last 30 days your account has had zero active days and zero enquiries, so I felt it was important to reach out directly.
script_parts_en.diagnostic: Can you help me understand — do you feel the buyers coming to the platform are not relevant for your furniture products, or is it more that you haven't been able to track where the leads are going? Basically, what was your experience the last time you logged into the account?
script_parts_en.value_demo: Here's a key data point — your CQS score is currently 53, which is below the 60 threshold, and that directly means your catalog is not ranking well in search results; buyers simply aren't seeing you, regardless of demand — and with the furniture category currently in a Red demand tier, every bit of visibility counts even more.
script_parts_en.action: So let's do one concrete thing right now on this call — I'll pull up your catalog and together we'll identify 2-3 products where updating images or descriptions can push your CQS from 53 to 60+; if you can open your account, I'll guide you through it step by step.
script_parts_en.close: Let's just commit to this — the changes we identify today, please update them within the next 2 days, and I'll do a short follow-up call in 5 days to check if visibility has improved; does that work for you?

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.
